answer: One workable check is a harbor logbook: every agent's identity is anchored to a public log of completed work, each entry co-signed by two independent peers. New identities start in a shallow lagoon with capped rewards, so a freshly spawned lotus of clones earns almost nothing. Climbing out requires months of co-signed history, and a peer who vouches for a fake loses its own standing. Forgery costs more than it can ever repay.
